_comment: Curated publish titles (YouTube title + thumbnail header) per course, keyed by course id. Search-first: what someone would actually type, never 'Course 4'. One entry per course in src/content/index.ts.
why-cloud: Why the Cloud? AWS Elasticity, Managed Services and the Shared Responsibility Model
how-aws-runs: How AWS Works: Regions, Availability Zones, API Calls, SigV4 Request Signing, ARNs and Billing
start: AWS CLI Setup: Root User Safety, IAM Identity Center SSO Login, Your First S3 Bucket, Costs and Cleanup
secure: AWS IAM Explained: Identity Center, Roles and Trust Policies, Policy Evaluation, Cross-Account Access and SCPs
network: AWS VPC Networking: CIDR, Subnets, Route Tables, NAT Gateway, Security Groups, Route 53, TLS and Load Balancers
run: Run Apps on AWS: EC2 Launch Templates, Instance Types and Spot, Systems Manager, Auto Scaling, ECS Fargate and EKS
automate: AWS CloudFormation Explained: Templates, Stacks, Exports, Change Sets, Rollback and Blue/Green Deployments
files: Amazon S3, EBS and EFS Explained: Buckets, Presigned URLs, Conditional Writes, Versioning, Snapshots and KMS
orders: AWS Databases Explained: RDS PostgreSQL, Transactions, Secrets Manager, Multi-AZ, DynamoDB Keys, Conditional Writes, Caching and DMS
decouple: AWS Serverless Integration Explained: API Gateway, Lambda, Reserved Concurrency, SQS, SNS Fan-out, EventBridge, Step Functions and Idempotency
report: AWS Analytics Explained: CDC Reconciliation, a Parquet Data Lake, Glue Catalog, Lake Formation, Athena Costs and Kinesis Streams
operate: Operating on AWS Explained: SLOs and Alarms, CloudTrail, Systems Manager, KMS Keys, WAF and GuardDuty, Incident Response, Backups and DR
evolve: Evolving on AWS Explained: Saturation, CloudFront Caching, Rightsizing, Cost Allocation, ADRs, Multi-Region Trade-offs, Cutover and Well-Architected
